question: How do I upload a video?
answer: Tap the + button in the bottom tab bar, pick a video from your gallery or record one, add a title and category, and tap Upload. Videos go through automatic moderation and category classification before they appear in the feed.

question: Why was my upload blocked?
answer: Uploads are blocked when our NSFW moderation flags adult or explicit content in any sampled frame. Choose different footage that follows the community guidelines and try again.

question: How does TrueVision categorize videos?
answer: Every upload is run through a DistilBERT classifier that assigns one of four categories: Educational, Professional, News, or Entertainment. The category drives ranking and recommendations.

question: How does the recommendation feed work?
answer: We score every candidate video on educational signal, watch-time, engagement, recency, and how well it matches your interests and watch history. Educational and Professional content gets a boost so the feed leans informative.

question: How do I edit or delete a comment?
answer: Long-press your own comment to open the action sheet. Choose Edit to change the text or Delete to remove it. Only the comment's owner sees these options.

question: How do I change my profile picture?
answer: Open the Profile tab, tap the avatar at the top of the screen, then choose Edit Profile and pick a new image from your gallery.

question: How do I enable dark mode?
answer: Open Settings, then Display, and toggle Dark Mode. The choice is saved locally and survives app restarts.

question: How do I save a video for later?
answer: Tap the bookmark icon on the right-hand action column while watching. Saved videos appear under Profile → Saved.

question: How do I report inappropriate content?
answer: Open the three-dot menu on any video and choose Report. Pick a reason; videos with five or more reports are automatically hidden pending review.

question: What file formats can I upload?
answer: TrueVision accepts MP4, MOV, WebM, and AVI files up to 500 MB. Longer clips are automatically compressed on the client before upload.

question: Why is my video processing slow?
answer: Large or high-resolution videos are compressed on-device before upload to save bandwidth. Compression progress is shown in the upload screen — bigger files take longer.

question: How do I follow another creator?
answer: Open their profile and tap Follow. Their latest uploads will appear in the Following tab on Home.

question: How do I find educational content?
answer: The home feed already prioritizes Educational and Professional categories. You can also use the search tab to look for specific topics, hashtags, or creators.

question: Can I download videos?
answer: Only when the creator has enabled downloads on that video. When allowed, the download icon on the action column unlocks; tap it to save a Cloudinary-signed copy to your device.

question: How do I sign out?
answer: Settings → Account → Log Out. You'll be returned to the login screen and your token is cleared from the device.
